study.rules: Bought at the next session's open, held for the period, left on a close under the exit line. Price returns before costs and tax. Index: Nifty 500.

long.method: Every liquid NSE stock is ranked on the measurements in the ledger. The list is the top of that ranking after the uptrend and volatility gates. Tested on NSE prices from 2017 to 2026.

legacy.label: Short-term setups
legacy.note: Setups whose premise plays out in weeks to a few months: strong trends with volume behind them, and accumulation footprints that haven't fully moved yet. These decay fastest — re-scan often.
legacy.horizon_note: Scored for the next few weeks: the market regime and any filing in the last three days carry real weight, because a breakout that has to fight the index usually loses.

staleness.text: Scanned 5 days ago. Short-term setups decay in days — re-run the universe scan before acting on these.

regime.label: Index comfortably above its 50-day average — trend setups have tailwind.

selection_notes: 3 further names met the setup but were held back by the 3-per-sector cap.
4 qualifying names excluded for thin liquidity — switch on 'include thin' to see them.
legacy.method: Every row is scored out of 100 across seven factors weighted for this horizon: setup fit, engine composite, sector outlook, market regime, catalyst, liquidity and the archetype's measured record. Open a row to see the points each factor contributed. A factor whose feed is unavailable scores neutral and says so.
